components.name: AppSidebar
components.summary: Left navigation rail for every logged-in platform (coach, business, managed coach, manager, learn).

components.name: AppTopbar
components.summary: Sticky page header for the logged-in platforms: page title + subtitle on the left, search and the profile button on the right.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Circular initials avatar on the primary gradient — used for candidates, coaches, the signed-in profile button and organisation badges.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill-shaped action button used across every surface — platform dashboards, account screens and marketing pages.

components.name: Card
components.summary: General-purpose surface for grouping content — the base unit for tiles, promo panels and bento layouts.

components.name: DropdownCard
components.summary: Collapsible card — same surface as Card with a header row and a chevron that animates the body's height and opacity.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Small toggleable filter pill used inside wizards and candidate pickers.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Pill-shaped segmented toggle for switching between mutually exclusive types (Individual / Group, Short form / Full form).

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Numbered progress stepper for the multi-step wizards (new group, new assignment).

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Underline tabs for switching a list's status filter (All / Active / Completed).

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Centered zero-state for filtered lists and empty tables.

components.name: Panel
components.summary: Card surface with an in-card header band and content that runs flush to the edges — the wrapper for every table and list on the platform dashboards.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: 6px completion track with a primary-gradient fill and a count label — used in assignment tables to show how many candidates have finished.

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: KPI tile at the top of every platform dashboard — centered icon, label, big number, small trend caption.

components.name: StatusDot
components.summary: 10px colored dot with a label, for assignment and candidate status lines.

components.name: SocialIcon
components.summary: Social link that cross-fades between its two SVG files on hover and scales to 1.2× with a drop shadow.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Small highlight chip for article categories, facet labels and status callouts.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: 32px square checkbox (register forms).

components.name: Input
components.summary: Standard text field: white-gradient fill, inset shadow, 16px radius, no visible border.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Dropdown trigger rendered as a primary-gradient pill button; menu is a white card that fades/slides in below it.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line counterpart to Input — same fill/shadow/radius, min-height 96px, vertical resize only.

components.name: ToggleSwitch
components.summary: 36×20 pill toggle (login "keep me logged in", settings).

components.name: Footer
components.summary: Site footer: a full-bleed primary-gradient block with all-white content, a 5-column top row and a divided bottom bar.

components.name: Header
components.summary: Site header: a floating white pill card on a white-to-transparent fade, so page content scrolls up underneath it.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Centered dialog on a 45%-black scrim, used for confirmations and as the shell for the multi-step group and assignment wizards.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Grid-based data table used across account/reports pages (namespaced pl- in the source CSS).

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: Sidebar rail, topbar and avatars for the logged-in platforms

components.name: Buttons
components.summary: One blue button (primary) plus secondary, ghost, danger, submit

components.name: Cards
components.summary: Base, gradient, hoverable and collapsible surfaces

components.name: Controls
components.summary: Tabs, segmented toggle, chips and the wizard stepper

components.name: Data
components.summary: Stat cards, panels, progress, status dots, empty state

components.name: Footer2
components.summary: Primary-gradient block, 5-column top row, divided bottom bar

components.name: Forms
components.summary: Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Toggle

components.name: Header2
components.summary: Floating white pill — nav, Resources dropdown, Request Demo, language, account

components.name: Modal2
components.summary: Dialog on a dark scrim, also the wizard shell

components.name: Table2
components.summary: Shared account/report table pattern

components.name: Tags
components.summary: Facet-coded chips and hover-swap social links
